Married Stanley James Bensussen in King County on 4 Sep 1983, on a Benton County licence of 1 Sep; they lived in Colorado in the 1990s and at Richland from 2002 (county marriage record; state index; public-records index). Mother of Michael, born May 1986, and Simon, born September 1989.
